<h2 id="longer-version">Longer version</h2>

<p>Copyrights in the Rust Standard Library are retained by their contributors. No copyright assignment is required to contribute to the Rust project.</p>

<p>Some files include explicit copyright notices and/or license notices. For full authorship information, see the version control history or <a href="https://thanks.rust-lang.org">https://thanks.rust-lang.org</a>.</p>

<p>Except as otherwise noted (below and/or in individual files), the Rust Standard Library is licensed under the <a href="http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0">Apache License, Version 2.0</a> or the <a href="http://opensource.org/licenses/MIT">MIT</a> license, at your option.</p>

<p>This file describes the copyright and licensing information for the source code within The Rust Project git tree related to the Rust Standard Library, and the third-party dependencies used when building the Rust Standard Library.</p>

applications retain their own document-font selection and licensing policy.

The Canon CRW decoder in crates/crw (src/lib.rs, src/tables.rs, src/tests.rs, tests/) and its
derivation record (crates/crw/clean-room/) come from:
- LightCraft, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw.rs, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw_tables.rs,
  crates/raw/tests/crw_oracle.rs, crates/raw/tests/it/vendor_robust.rs and clean-room/crw/,
  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3021, revision 6ca439b5155820d2befeacd81ec0c6a80b2bd3bc

  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft
  Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the LightCraft contributors.
Its white-level plateau estimate (saturation_plateau) is LightCraft's vendor::white_from_data at the
same revision. The CRW compression was derived clean-room from CC0 sample files and the
maintainer's own photographs by black-box comparison with a reference decoder's command-line
output; no raw-decoder source was consulted (crates/crw/clean-room/sources.md).

crates/audio/src/alac/ (the ALAC decoder and encoder) is ported from Apple's ALAC reference
implementation, https://github.com/macosforge/alac at c38887c5c5e64a4b31108733bd79ca9b2496d987
(codec/), Copyright (c) 2011 Apple Inc., licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
(LICENSE-APACHE). The files are modified: translated to Rust, with bounds checks on hostile input,
wrapping integer arithmetic, the unrolled predictor and per-width matrix routines folded into one,
and the average bit rate filled in. Those files are Apache-2.0 only.

list (author, source, license) is in ATTRIBUTION.md.

  characterisation data below.
crates/cms/tests/data/FOGRA39.txt: FOGRA39 characterisation data, distributed unmodified.
  Source: Fogra (Fogra Forschungsinstitut für Medientechnologien e.V.), www.fogra.org, from
  https://fogra.org/fileadmin/files/7_downloads/Charakterisierungsdaten/FOGRA39_to_FOGRA60_v2.zip

  FOGRAxx may be used solely to identify the respective reference data. Such use does not
  imply certification, approval or endorsement by Fogra."

  Grady Ward (Project Gutenberg eBook #3204).
crates/proof/data/en-words.dic: public domain, the words of the Moby Hyphenator II list by Grady
  Ward (Project Gutenberg eBook #3204), without its break points.
crates/proof/data/en-extra.txt: MIT OR Apache-2.0, WordCraft contributors' own list of modern
  English words (a copy of craft-i18n's language-data/en-us/en-extra.txt).

Optional PDF writer

Krilla 0.8.2 (https://github.com/LaurenzV/krilla), MIT OR Apache-2.0.
Upstream licence texts are retained in licenses/pdf-writer.
The optional writer embeds Compact ICC Profiles by Clinton Ingram
(https://github.com/saucecontrol/Compact-ICC-Profiles), under CC0-1.0.
See licenses/pdf-writer/LICENSE-ICC.txt and ATTRIBUTION.md for sources and hashes.
The writer adds no font files. Its four existing ICC profiles are retained under vendor/krilla/icc.

Krilla is vendored with the local patches in vendor/krilla/patches; see vendor/krilla/README.craft.md
and vendor/krilla/SOURCE.json. Its upstream MIT/Apache-2.0 licences and CC0 profiles are unchanged.

Optional PDF reader

Hayro 0.7.1, hayro-interpret 0.7.0, hayro-syntax 0.7.2, hayro-jbig2 0.3.0, hayro-cmap 0.1.0
and hayro-postscript 0.1.0 (https://github.com/LaurenzV/hayro), MIT OR Apache-2.0, retain their
upstream licence files. The first five are patched sources transferred from PdfCraft
(https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft): hayro-cmap from revision
a2ec27b4775f53c40cad3456936d9406611e3a8d, the others from revision
ec0a965074f376a5bf610435948e4e5184bf3299. hayro-postscript is the crates.io 0.1.0 package
(upstream revision a2354aebaf86f5ab13e5fd6b6b0521306488bf9d) with one local patch.
See vendor/README.craft-reader.md and each crate's SOURCE.json for provenance and local changes.
The hayro-interpret plate mode (separations, overprint and output-intent simulation) is ported
from PdfCraft pull request #2770 by Guillem Hermida, commit
6fcf2a4aca29e943e28cb69017ff8f87d00656c6 (https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2770),
MIT OR Apache-2.0; crates/pdf/tests/plates.rs and tests/support/synthetic_icc.rs adapt its tests.
Knockout transparency groups in hayro-interpret and hayro are ported from PdfCraft pull request
#2974 by mtlcl410, commit bae69819594a6385a027fec1f67e6b3c36c259b4
(https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2974), MIT OR Apache-2.0;
crates/pdf/tests/knockout.rs adapts its test.
The reader retains the existing Foxit/PDFium standard-14 font assets (BSD-3-Clause),
Compact ICC Profiles by Clinton Ingram (CC0-1.0), and dependency CMaps (BSD-3-Clause).
Their licences and per-file hashes are retained in vendor/hayro-interpret/assets,
vendor/hayro-cmap/assets, licenses/pdf-backend and ATTRIBUTION.md. These are existing reader dependency assets;
applications retain their own document-font selection and licensing policy.

The Canon CRW decoder in crates/crw (src/lib.rs, src/tables.rs, src/tests.rs, tests/) and its
derivation record (crates/crw/clean-room/) come from:
- LightCraft, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw.rs, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw_tables.rs,
  crates/raw/tests/crw_oracle.rs, crates/raw/tests/it/vendor_robust.rs and clean-room/crw/,
  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3021, revision 6ca439b5155820d2befeacd81ec0c6a80b2bd3bc
  (decoder ported at 70c755e42a65661401142819278d51b0c5977f7f; the record is identical at both).
  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft
  Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the LightCraft contributors.
Its white-level plateau estimate (saturation_plateau) is LightCraft's vendor::white_from_data at the
same revision. The CRW compression was derived clean-room from CC0 sample files and the
maintainer's own photographs by black-box comparison with a reference decoder's command-line
output; no raw-decoder source was consulted (crates/crw/clean-room/sources.md).

crates/audio/src/alac/ (the ALAC decoder and encoder) is ported from Apple's ALAC reference
implementation, https://github.com/macosforge/alac at c38887c5c5e64a4b31108733bd79ca9b2496d987
(codec/), Copyright (c) 2011 Apple Inc., licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
(LICENSE-APACHE). The files are modified: translated to Rust, with bounds checks on hostile input,
wrapping integer arithmetic, the unrolled predictor and per-width matrix routines folded into one,
and the average bit rate filled in. Those files are Apache-2.0 only.

The Canon CRW decoder in crates/crw (src/lib.rs, src/tables.rs, src/tests.rs, tests/) and its
derivation record (crates/crw/clean-room/) come from:
- LightCraft, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw.rs, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw_tables.rs,
  crates/raw/tests/crw_oracle.rs, crates/raw/tests/it/vendor_robust.rs and clean-room/crw/,
  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3021, revision 6ca439b5155820d2befeacd81ec0c6a80b2bd3bc

maintainer's own photographs by black-box comparison with a reference decoder's command-line
output; no raw-decoder source was consulted (crates/crw/clean-room/sources.md).

crates/audio/src/alac/ (the ALAC decoder and encoder) is ported from Apple's ALAC reference
implementation, https://github.com/macosforge/alac at c38887c5c5e64a4b31108733bd79ca9b2496d987
(codec/), Copyright (c) 2011 Apple Inc., licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
(LICENSE-APACHE). The files are modified: translated to Rust, with bounds checks on hostile input,
wrapping integer arithmetic, the unrolled predictor and per-width matrix routines folded into one,
and the average bit rate filled in. Those files are Apache-2.0 only.

The Canon CRW decoder in crates/crw (src/lib.rs, src/tables.rs, src/tests.rs, tests/) and its
derivation record (crates/crw/clean-room/) come from:
- LightCraft, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw.rs, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw_tables.rs,
  crates/raw/tests/crw_oracle.rs, crates/raw/tests/it/vendor_robust.rs and clean-room/crw/,
  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3021, revision 6ca439b5155820d2befeacd81ec0c6a80b2bd3bc
  (decoder ported at 70c755e42a65661401142819278d51b0c5977f7f; the record is identical at both).
  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft
  Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the LightCraft contributors.
Its white-level plateau estimate (saturation_plateau) is LightCraft's vendor::white_from_data at the
same revision. The CRW compression was derived clean-room from CC0 sample files and the
maintainer's own photographs by black-box comparison with a reference decoder's command-line
output; no raw-decoder source was consulted (crates/crw/clean-room/sources.md).

crates/audio/src/alac/ (the ALAC decoder and encoder) is ported from Apple's ALAC reference
implementation, https://github.com/macosforge/alac at c38887c5c5e64a4b31108733bd79ca9b2496d987
(codec/), Copyright (c) 2011 Apple Inc., licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
(LICENSE-APACHE). The files are modified: translated to Rust, with bounds checks on hostile input,
wrapping integer arithmetic, the unrolled predictor and per-width matrix routines folded into one,
and the average bit rate filled in. Those files are Apache-2.0 only.

and current application implementations:

- CADCraft apps/cadcraft/src/desktop_theme.rs, 0cc66ad3066e71f2c3d4cacb7de905e79ba1c95b.
- ArtCraft Launcher apps/artcraft-launcher/src/system_theme.rs, f1676dfb41c226b5be490721f486ee6427419d80.
- Earlier PhotoCraft, FilmCraft and EffectCraft appearance services at revisions
  0c72d95425dece90ef9a1cceb49e3315c96e22d5, 794a25fc9ed2e3f6fab51a254625bc9b99a88015
  and 1b4d47f34f2b1c1b4a89f4b7348889def8fd648b respectively.
Sources: https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft, https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft,
https://github.com/storytold/craft-launcher, https://github.com/storytold/photocraft,
https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft, https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft.
Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the respective application and craft-libs contributors.
All adapted source is licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0.

The Canon CRW decoder in crates/crw (src/lib.rs, src/tables.rs, src/tests.rs, tests/) and its
derivation record (crates/crw/clean-room/) come from:
- LightCraft, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw.rs, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw_tables.rs,
  crates/raw/tests/crw_oracle.rs, crates/raw/tests/it/vendor_robust.rs and clean-room/crw/,
  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3021, revision 6ca439b5155820d2befeacd81ec0c6a80b2bd3bc
  (decoder ported at 70c755e42a65661401142819278d51b0c5977f7f; the record is identical at both).
  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft
  Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the LightCraft contributors.
Its white-level plateau estimate (saturation_plateau) is LightCraft's vendor::white_from_data at the
same revision. The CRW compression was derived clean-room from CC0 sample files and the
maintainer's own photographs by black-box comparison with a reference decoder's command-line
output; no raw-decoder source was consulted (crates/crw/clean-room/sources.md).

crates/audio/src/alac/ (the ALAC decoder and encoder) is ported from Apple's ALAC reference
implementation, https://github.com/macosforge/alac at c38887c5c5e64a4b31108733bd79ca9b2496d987
(codec/), Copyright (c) 2011 Apple Inc., licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
(LICENSE-APACHE). The files are modified: translated to Rust, with bounds checks on hostile input,
wrapping integer arithmetic, the unrolled predictor and per-width matrix routines folded into one,
and the average bit rate filled in. Those files are Apache-2.0 only.

crates/pdf/tests/knockout.rs adapts its test.
The reader retains the existing Foxit/PDFium standard-14 font assets (BSD-3-Clause),
Compact ICC Profiles by Clinton Ingram (CC0-1.0), and dependency CMaps (BSD-3-Clause).
Their licences and per-file hashes are retained in vendor/hayro-interpret/assets,
vendor/hayro-cmap/assets, licenses/pdf-backend and ATTRIBUTION.md. These are existing reader dependency assets;
applications retain their own document-font selection and licensing policy.

linesweeper

linesweeper 0.5.0 (https://crates.io/crates/linesweeper/0.5.0), MIT OR Apache-2.0, is stored in
vendor/linesweeper with its upstream license files and one local patch. Its manifest names Joe Neeman
as author, and its LICENSE-MIT reads "Copyright (c) 2018 Raph Levien". See
vendor/linesweeper/README.craft.md and vendor/linesweeper/SOURCE.json for provenance, the local patch
and the files left out.

Platform lifecycle source provenance

The optional crates/platform services adapt the preserved local platform candidate
9b135779a1e7136438a217c18afe1693ea23f1ab (dialog outcomes and browser resource ownership),
and current application implementations:
- PdfCraft crates/platform/src/desktop_theme.rs, a8cd797a917b1007544575c7280c9a0ce6a17e8f.
- CADCraft apps/cadcraft/src/desktop_theme.rs, 0cc66ad3066e71f2c3d4cacb7de905e79ba1c95b.
- ArtCraft Launcher apps/artcraft-launcher/src/system_theme.rs, f1676dfb41c226b5be490721f486ee6427419d80.
- Earlier PhotoCraft, FilmCraft and EffectCraft appearance services at revisions
  0c72d95425dece90ef9a1cceb49e3315c96e22d5, 794a25fc9ed2e3f6fab51a254625bc9b99a88015
  and 1b4d47f34f2b1c1b4a89f4b7348889def8fd648b respectively.
Sources: https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft, https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft,
https://github.com/storytold/craft-launcher, https://github.com/storytold/photocraft,
https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft, https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft.
Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the respective application and craft-libs contributors.
All adapted source is licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0.

The Canon CRW decoder in crates/crw (src/lib.rs, src/tables.rs, src/tests.rs, tests/) and its
derivation record (crates/crw/clean-room/) come from:
- LightCraft, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw.rs, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw_tables.rs,
  crates/raw/tests/crw_oracle.rs, crates/raw/tests/it/vendor_robust.rs and clean-room/crw/,
  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3021, revision 6ca439b5155820d2befeacd81ec0c6a80b2bd3bc
  (decoder ported at 70c755e42a65661401142819278d51b0c5977f7f; the record is identical at both).
  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft
  Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the LightCraft contributors.
Its white-level plateau estimate (saturation_plateau) is LightCraft's vendor::white_from_data at the
same revision. The CRW compression was derived clean-room from CC0 sample files and the
maintainer's own photographs by black-box comparison with a reference decoder's command-line
output; no raw-decoder source was consulted (crates/crw/clean-room/sources.md).

crates/audio/src/alac/ (the ALAC decoder and encoder) is ported from Apple's ALAC reference
implementation, https://github.com/macosforge/alac at c38887c5c5e64a4b31108733bd79ca9b2496d987
(codec/), Copyright (c) 2011 Apple Inc., licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
(LICENSE-APACHE). The files are modified: translated to Rust, with bounds checks on hostile input,
wrapping integer arithmetic, the unrolled predictor and per-width matrix routines folded into one,
and the average bit rate filled in. Those files are Apache-2.0 only.

a2ec27b4775f53c40cad3456936d9406611e3a8d, the others from revision
ec0a965074f376a5bf610435948e4e5184bf3299. hayro-postscript is the crates.io 0.1.0 package
(upstream revision a2354aebaf86f5ab13e5fd6b6b0521306488bf9d) with one local patch.
See vendor/README.craft-reader.md and each crate's SOURCE.json for provenance and local changes.
The hayro-interpret plate mode (separations, overprint and output-intent simulation) is ported
from PdfCraft pull request #2770 by Guillem Hermida, commit
6fcf2a4aca29e943e28cb69017ff8f87d00656c6 (https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2770),
MIT OR Apache-2.0; crates/pdf/tests/plates.rs and tests/support/synthetic_icc.rs adapt its tests.
Knockout transparency groups in hayro-interpret and hayro are ported from PdfCraft pull request
#2974 by mtlcl410, commit bae69819594a6385a027fec1f67e6b3c36c259b4
(https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2974), MIT OR Apache-2.0;
crates/pdf/tests/knockout.rs adapts its test.
The reader retains the existing Foxit/PDFium standard-14 font assets (BSD-3-Clause),
Compact ICC Profiles by Clinton Ingram (CC0-1.0), and dependency CMaps (BSD-3-Clause).
Their licences and per-file hashes are retained in vendor/hayro-interpret/assets,
vendor/hayro-cmap/assets, licenses/pdf-backend and ATTRIBUTION.md. These are existing reader dependency assets;
applications retain their own document-font selection and licensing policy.

linesweeper

linesweeper 0.5.0 (https://crates.io/crates/linesweeper/0.5.0), MIT OR Apache-2.0, is stored in
vendor/linesweeper with its upstream license files and one local patch. Its manifest names Joe Neeman
as author, and its LICENSE-MIT reads "Copyright (c) 2018 Raph Levien". See
vendor/linesweeper/README.craft.md and vendor/linesweeper/SOURCE.json for provenance, the local patch
and the files left out.

Platform lifecycle source provenance

The optional crates/platform services adapt the preserved local platform candidate
9b135779a1e7136438a217c18afe1693ea23f1ab (dialog outcomes and browser resource ownership),
and current application implementations:
- PdfCraft crates/platform/src/desktop_theme.rs, a8cd797a917b1007544575c7280c9a0ce6a17e8f.
- CADCraft apps/cadcraft/src/desktop_theme.rs, 0cc66ad3066e71f2c3d4cacb7de905e79ba1c95b.
- ArtCraft Launcher apps/artcraft-launcher/src/system_theme.rs, f1676dfb41c226b5be490721f486ee6427419d80.
- Earlier PhotoCraft, FilmCraft and EffectCraft appearance services at revisions
  0c72d95425dece90ef9a1cceb49e3315c96e22d5, 794a25fc9ed2e3f6fab51a254625bc9b99a88015
  and 1b4d47f34f2b1c1b4a89f4b7348889def8fd648b respectively.
Sources: https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft, https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft,
https://github.com/storytold/craft-launcher, https://github.com/storytold/photocraft,
https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft, https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft.
Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the respective application and craft-libs contributors.
All adapted source is licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0.

The Canon CRW decoder in crates/crw (src/lib.rs, src/tables.rs, src/tests.rs, tests/) and its
derivation record (crates/crw/clean-room/) come from:
- LightCraft, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw.rs, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw_tables.rs,
  crates/raw/tests/crw_oracle.rs, crates/raw/tests/it/vendor_robust.rs and clean-room/crw/,
  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3021, revision 6ca439b5155820d2befeacd81ec0c6a80b2bd3bc
  (decoder ported at 70c755e42a65661401142819278d51b0c5977f7f; the record is identical at both).
  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft
  Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the LightCraft contributors.
Its white-level plateau estimate (saturation_plateau) is LightCraft's vendor::white_from_data at the
same revision. The CRW compression was derived clean-room from CC0 sample files and the
maintainer's own photographs by black-box comparison with a reference decoder's command-line
output; no raw-decoder source was consulted (crates/crw/clean-room/sources.md).

crates/audio/src/alac/ (the ALAC decoder and encoder) is ported from Apple's ALAC reference
implementation, https://github.com/macosforge/alac at c38887c5c5e64a4b31108733bd79ca9b2496d987
(codec/), Copyright (c) 2011 Apple Inc., licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
(LICENSE-APACHE). The files are modified: translated to Rust, with bounds checks on hostile input,
wrapping integer arithmetic, the unrolled predictor and per-width matrix routines folded into one,
and the average bit rate filled in. Those files are Apache-2.0 only.

See licenses/pdf-writer/LICENSE-ICC.txt and ATTRIBUTION.md for sources and hashes.
The writer adds no font files. Its four existing ICC profiles are retained under vendor/krilla/icc.

Krilla is vendored with the local patches in vendor/krilla/patches; see vendor/krilla/README.craft.md
and vendor/krilla/SOURCE.json. Its upstream MIT/Apache-2.0 licences and CC0 profiles are unchanged.

Optional PDF reader

Hayro 0.7.1, hayro-interpret 0.7.0, hayro-syntax 0.7.2, hayro-jbig2 0.3.0, hayro-cmap 0.1.0
and hayro-postscript 0.1.0 (https://github.com/LaurenzV/hayro), MIT OR Apache-2.0, retain their
upstream licence files. The first five are patched sources transferred from PdfCraft
(https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft): hayro-cmap from revision
a2ec27b4775f53c40cad3456936d9406611e3a8d, the others from revision
ec0a965074f376a5bf610435948e4e5184bf3299. hayro-postscript is the crates.io 0.1.0 package
(upstream revision a2354aebaf86f5ab13e5fd6b6b0521306488bf9d) with one local patch.
See vendor/README.craft-reader.md and each crate's SOURCE.json for provenance and local changes.
The hayro-interpret plate mode (separations, overprint and output-intent simulation) is ported
from PdfCraft pull request #2770 by Guillem Hermida, commit
6fcf2a4aca29e943e28cb69017ff8f87d00656c6 (https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2770),
MIT OR Apache-2.0; crates/pdf/tests/plates.rs and tests/support/synthetic_icc.rs adapt its tests.
Knockout transparency groups in hayro-interpret and hayro are ported from PdfCraft pull request
#2974 by mtlcl410, commit bae69819594a6385a027fec1f67e6b3c36c259b4
(https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2974), MIT OR Apache-2.0;
crates/pdf/tests/knockout.rs adapts its test.
The reader retains the existing Foxit/PDFium standard-14 font assets (BSD-3-Clause),
Compact ICC Profiles by Clinton Ingram (CC0-1.0), and dependency CMaps (BSD-3-Clause).
Their licences and per-file hashes are retained in vendor/hayro-interpret/assets,
vendor/hayro-cmap/assets, licenses/pdf-backend and ATTRIBUTION.md. These are existing reader dependency assets;
applications retain their own document-font selection and licensing policy.

linesweeper

linesweeper 0.5.0 (https://crates.io/crates/linesweeper/0.5.0), MIT OR Apache-2.0, is stored in
vendor/linesweeper with its upstream license files and one local patch. Its manifest names Joe Neeman
as author, and its LICENSE-MIT reads "Copyright (c) 2018 Raph Levien". See
vendor/linesweeper/README.craft.md and vendor/linesweeper/SOURCE.json for provenance, the local patch
and the files left out.

Platform lifecycle source provenance

The optional crates/platform services adapt the preserved local platform candidate
9b135779a1e7136438a217c18afe1693ea23f1ab (dialog outcomes and browser resource ownership),
and current application implementations:
- PdfCraft crates/platform/src/desktop_theme.rs, a8cd797a917b1007544575c7280c9a0ce6a17e8f.
- CADCraft apps/cadcraft/src/desktop_theme.rs, 0cc66ad3066e71f2c3d4cacb7de905e79ba1c95b.
- ArtCraft Launcher apps/artcraft-launcher/src/system_theme.rs, f1676dfb41c226b5be490721f486ee6427419d80.
- Earlier PhotoCraft, FilmCraft and EffectCraft appearance services at revisions
  0c72d95425dece90ef9a1cceb49e3315c96e22d5, 794a25fc9ed2e3f6fab51a254625bc9b99a88015
  and 1b4d47f34f2b1c1b4a89f4b7348889def8fd648b respectively.
Sources: https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft, https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft,
https://github.com/storytold/craft-launcher, https://github.com/storytold/photocraft,
https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft, https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft.
Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the respective application and craft-libs contributors.
All adapted source is licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0.

The Canon CRW decoder in crates/crw (src/lib.rs, src/tables.rs, src/tests.rs, tests/) and its
derivation record (crates/crw/clean-room/) come from:
- LightCraft, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw.rs, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw_tables.rs,
  crates/raw/tests/crw_oracle.rs, crates/raw/tests/it/vendor_robust.rs and clean-room/crw/,
  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3021, revision 6ca439b5155820d2befeacd81ec0c6a80b2bd3bc
  (decoder ported at 70c755e42a65661401142819278d51b0c5977f7f; the record is identical at both).
  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft
  Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the LightCraft contributors.
Its white-level plateau estimate (saturation_plateau) is LightCraft's vendor::white_from_data at the
same revision. The CRW compression was derived clean-room from CC0 sample files and the
maintainer's own photographs by black-box comparison with a reference decoder's command-line
output; no raw-decoder source was consulted (crates/crw/clean-room/sources.md).

crates/audio/src/alac/ (the ALAC decoder and encoder) is ported from Apple's ALAC reference
implementation, https://github.com/macosforge/alac at c38887c5c5e64a4b31108733bd79ca9b2496d987
(codec/), Copyright (c) 2011 Apple Inc., licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
(LICENSE-APACHE). The files are modified: translated to Rust, with bounds checks on hostile input,
wrapping integer arithmetic, the unrolled predictor and per-width matrix routines folded into one,
and the average bit rate filled in. Those files are Apache-2.0 only.

  Higgs32584, itsF4LCON, jason4short, Korg1ch, MarekSpodBiedry and Nigel Ihza Firdausy.
  Licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0. PhotoCraft's menus, theme and Help search are not copied.

The colour management module in crates/cms is extracted from:
- PhotoCraft, crates/cms, revision b3222ee8e7e6bcb4799c37f904c595f20f9baf5e.
  https://github.com/storytold/photocraft
  Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the PhotoCraft contributors.
  Licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0. Its generated ICC profile is dedicated to the public domain
  (CC0-1.0); see ATTRIBUTION.md.

Optional PDF writer

Krilla 0.8.2 (https://github.com/LaurenzV/krilla), MIT OR Apache-2.0.
Upstream licence texts are retained in licenses/pdf-writer.
The optional writer embeds Compact ICC Profiles by Clinton Ingram
(https://github.com/saucecontrol/Compact-ICC-Profiles), under CC0-1.0.
See licenses/pdf-writer/LICENSE-ICC.txt and ATTRIBUTION.md for sources and hashes.
The writer adds no font files. Its four existing ICC profiles are retained under vendor/krilla/icc.

Krilla is vendored with the local patches in vendor/krilla/patches; see vendor/krilla/README.craft.md
and vendor/krilla/SOURCE.json. Its upstream MIT/Apache-2.0 licences and CC0 profiles are unchanged.

Optional PDF reader

Hayro 0.7.1, hayro-interpret 0.7.0, hayro-syntax 0.7.2, hayro-jbig2 0.3.0, hayro-cmap 0.1.0
and hayro-postscript 0.1.0 (https://github.com/LaurenzV/hayro), MIT OR Apache-2.0, retain their
upstream licence files. The first five are patched sources transferred from PdfCraft
(https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft): hayro-cmap from revision
a2ec27b4775f53c40cad3456936d9406611e3a8d, the others from revision
ec0a965074f376a5bf610435948e4e5184bf3299. hayro-postscript is the crates.io 0.1.0 package
(upstream revision a2354aebaf86f5ab13e5fd6b6b0521306488bf9d) with one local patch.
See vendor/README.craft-reader.md and each crate's SOURCE.json for provenance and local changes.
The hayro-interpret plate mode (separations, overprint and output-intent simulation) is ported
from PdfCraft pull request #2770 by Guillem Hermida, commit
6fcf2a4aca29e943e28cb69017ff8f87d00656c6 (https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2770),
MIT OR Apache-2.0; crates/pdf/tests/plates.rs and tests/support/synthetic_icc.rs adapt its tests.
Knockout transparency groups in hayro-interpret and hayro are ported from PdfCraft pull request
#2974 by mtlcl410, commit bae69819594a6385a027fec1f67e6b3c36c259b4
(https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2974), MIT OR Apache-2.0;
crates/pdf/tests/knockout.rs adapts its test.
The reader retains the existing Foxit/PDFium standard-14 font assets (BSD-3-Clause),
Compact ICC Profiles by Clinton Ingram (CC0-1.0), and dependency CMaps (BSD-3-Clause).
Their licences and per-file hashes are retained in vendor/hayro-interpret/assets,
vendor/hayro-cmap/assets, licenses/pdf-backend and ATTRIBUTION.md. These are existing reader dependency assets;
applications retain their own document-font selection and licensing policy.

linesweeper

linesweeper 0.5.0 (https://crates.io/crates/linesweeper/0.5.0), MIT OR Apache-2.0, is stored in
vendor/linesweeper with its upstream license files and one local patch. Its manifest names Joe Neeman
as author, and its LICENSE-MIT reads "Copyright (c) 2018 Raph Levien". See
vendor/linesweeper/README.craft.md and vendor/linesweeper/SOURCE.json for provenance, the local patch
and the files left out.

Platform lifecycle source provenance

The optional crates/platform services adapt the preserved local platform candidate
9b135779a1e7136438a217c18afe1693ea23f1ab (dialog outcomes and browser resource ownership),
and current application implementations:
- PdfCraft crates/platform/src/desktop_theme.rs, a8cd797a917b1007544575c7280c9a0ce6a17e8f.
- CADCraft apps/cadcraft/src/desktop_theme.rs, 0cc66ad3066e71f2c3d4cacb7de905e79ba1c95b.
- ArtCraft Launcher apps/artcraft-launcher/src/system_theme.rs, f1676dfb41c226b5be490721f486ee6427419d80.
- Earlier PhotoCraft, FilmCraft and EffectCraft appearance services at revisions
  0c72d95425dece90ef9a1cceb49e3315c96e22d5, 794a25fc9ed2e3f6fab51a254625bc9b99a88015
  and 1b4d47f34f2b1c1b4a89f4b7348889def8fd648b respectively.
Sources: https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft, https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft,
https://github.com/storytold/craft-launcher, https://github.com/storytold/photocraft,
https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft, https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft.
Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the respective application and craft-libs contributors.
All adapted source is licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0.

The Canon CRW decoder in crates/crw (src/lib.rs, src/tables.rs, src/tests.rs, tests/) and its
derivation record (crates/crw/clean-room/) come from:
- LightCraft, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw.rs, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw_tables.rs,
  crates/raw/tests/crw_oracle.rs, crates/raw/tests/it/vendor_robust.rs and clean-room/crw/,
  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3021, revision 6ca439b5155820d2befeacd81ec0c6a80b2bd3bc
  (decoder ported at 70c755e42a65661401142819278d51b0c5977f7f; the record is identical at both).
  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft
  Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the LightCraft contributors.
Its white-level plateau estimate (saturation_plateau) is LightCraft's vendor::white_from_data at the
same revision. The CRW compression was derived clean-room from CC0 sample files and the
maintainer's own photographs by black-box comparison with a reference decoder's command-line
output; no raw-decoder source was consulted (crates/crw/clean-room/sources.md).

crates/audio/src/alac/ (the ALAC decoder and encoder) is ported from Apple's ALAC reference
implementation, https://github.com/macosforge/alac at c38887c5c5e64a4b31108733bd79ca9b2496d987
(codec/), Copyright (c) 2011 Apple Inc., licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
(LICENSE-APACHE). The files are modified: translated to Rust, with bounds checks on hostile input,
wrapping integer arithmetic, the unrolled predictor and per-width matrix routines folded into one,
and the average bit rate filled in. Those files are Apache-2.0 only.

  menu_keys_tests.rs, and the menu bar in crates/ui-egui/src/menus.rs, revision
  c36e46c3873ee39f299cc50a3dcd28494c78366d.
  https://github.com/storytold/photocraft
  Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the PhotoCraft contributors, among them aiongg, artman67,
  BFlat, Brandon Thomas, Brennan Stehling, Daniel Lošák, David Mann, Fabio Lissi, FredApps,
  Higgs32584, itsF4LCON, jason4short, Korg1ch, MarekSpodBiedry and Nigel Ihza Firdausy.
  Licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0. PhotoCraft's menus, theme and Help search are not copied.

The colour management module in crates/cms is extracted from:
- PhotoCraft, crates/cms, revision b3222ee8e7e6bcb4799c37f904c595f20f9baf5e.
  https://github.com/storytold/photocraft
  Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the PhotoCraft contributors.
  Licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0. Its generated ICC profile is dedicated to the public domain
  (CC0-1.0); see ATTRIBUTION.md.

Optional PDF writer

Krilla 0.8.2 (https://github.com/LaurenzV/krilla), MIT OR Apache-2.0.
Upstream licence texts are retained in licenses/pdf-writer.
The optional writer embeds Compact ICC Profiles by Clinton Ingram
(https://github.com/saucecontrol/Compact-ICC-Profiles), under CC0-1.0.
See licenses/pdf-writer/LICENSE-ICC.txt and ATTRIBUTION.md for sources and hashes.
The writer adds no font files. Its four existing ICC profiles are retained under vendor/krilla/icc.

Krilla is vendored with the local patches in vendor/krilla/patches; see vendor/krilla/README.craft.md
and vendor/krilla/SOURCE.json. Its upstream MIT/Apache-2.0 licences and CC0 profiles are unchanged.

Optional PDF reader

Hayro 0.7.1, hayro-interpret 0.7.0, hayro-syntax 0.7.2, hayro-jbig2 0.3.0, hayro-cmap 0.1.0
and hayro-postscript 0.1.0 (https://github.com/LaurenzV/hayro), MIT OR Apache-2.0, retain their
upstream licence files. The first five are patched sources transferred from PdfCraft
(https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft): hayro-cmap from revision
a2ec27b4775f53c40cad3456936d9406611e3a8d, the others from revision
ec0a965074f376a5bf610435948e4e5184bf3299. hayro-postscript is the crates.io 0.1.0 package
(upstream revision a2354aebaf86f5ab13e5fd6b6b0521306488bf9d) with one local patch.
See vendor/README.craft-reader.md and each crate's SOURCE.json for provenance and local changes.
The hayro-interpret plate mode (separations, overprint and output-intent simulation) is ported
from PdfCraft pull request #2770 by Guillem Hermida, commit
6fcf2a4aca29e943e28cb69017ff8f87d00656c6 (https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2770),
MIT OR Apache-2.0; crates/pdf/tests/plates.rs and tests/support/synthetic_icc.rs adapt its tests.
Knockout transparency groups in hayro-interpret and hayro are ported from PdfCraft pull request
#2974 by mtlcl410, commit bae69819594a6385a027fec1f67e6b3c36c259b4
(https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2974), MIT OR Apache-2.0;
crates/pdf/tests/knockout.rs adapts its test.
The reader retains the existing Foxit/PDFium standard-14 font assets (BSD-3-Clause),
Compact ICC Profiles by Clinton Ingram (CC0-1.0), and dependency CMaps (BSD-3-Clause).
Their licences and per-file hashes are retained in vendor/hayro-interpret/assets,
vendor/hayro-cmap/assets, licenses/pdf-backend and ATTRIBUTION.md. These are existing reader dependency assets;
applications retain their own document-font selection and licensing policy.

linesweeper

linesweeper 0.5.0 (https://crates.io/crates/linesweeper/0.5.0), MIT OR Apache-2.0, is stored in
vendor/linesweeper with its upstream license files and no file changed. Its manifest names Joe Neeman
as author, and its LICENSE-MIT reads "Copyright (c) 2018 Raph Levien". See
vendor/linesweeper/README.craft.md and vendor/linesweeper/SOURCE.json for provenance and the files
left out.

Platform lifecycle source provenance

The optional crates/platform services adapt the preserved local platform candidate
9b135779a1e7136438a217c18afe1693ea23f1ab (dialog outcomes and browser resource ownership),
and current application implementations:
- PdfCraft crates/platform/src/desktop_theme.rs, a8cd797a917b1007544575c7280c9a0ce6a17e8f.
- CADCraft apps/cadcraft/src/desktop_theme.rs, 0cc66ad3066e71f2c3d4cacb7de905e79ba1c95b.
- ArtCraft Launcher apps/artcraft-launcher/src/system_theme.rs, f1676dfb41c226b5be490721f486ee6427419d80.
- Earlier PhotoCraft, FilmCraft and EffectCraft appearance services at revisions
  0c72d95425dece90ef9a1cceb49e3315c96e22d5, 794a25fc9ed2e3f6fab51a254625bc9b99a88015
  and 1b4d47f34f2b1c1b4a89f4b7348889def8fd648b respectively.
Sources: https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft, https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft,
https://github.com/storytold/craft-launcher, https://github.com/storytold/photocraft,
https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft, https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft.
Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the respective application and craft-libs contributors.
All adapted source is licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0.

The Canon CRW decoder in crates/crw (src/lib.rs, src/tables.rs, src/tests.rs, tests/) and its
derivation record (crates/crw/clean-room/) come from:
- LightCraft, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw.rs, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw_tables.rs,
  crates/raw/tests/crw_oracle.rs, crates/raw/tests/it/vendor_robust.rs and clean-room/crw/,
  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3021, revision 6ca439b5155820d2befeacd81ec0c6a80b2bd3bc
  (decoder ported at 70c755e42a65661401142819278d51b0c5977f7f; the record is identical at both).
  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft
  Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the LightCraft contributors.
Its white-level plateau estimate (saturation_plateau) is LightCraft's vendor::white_from_data at the
same revision. The CRW compression was derived clean-room from CC0 sample files and the
maintainer's own photographs by black-box comparison with a reference decoder's command-line
output; no raw-decoder source was consulted (crates/crw/clean-room/sources.md).

crates/audio/src/alac/ (the ALAC decoder and encoder) is ported from Apple's ALAC reference
implementation, https://github.com/macosforge/alac at c38887c5c5e64a4b31108733bd79ca9b2496d987
(codec/), Copyright (c) 2011 Apple Inc., licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
(LICENSE-APACHE). The files are modified: translated to Rust, with bounds checks on hostile input,
wrapping integer arithmetic, the unrolled predictor and per-width matrix routines folded into one,
and the average bit rate filled in. Those files are Apache-2.0 only.

- VectorCraft, apps/vectorcraft/src/mac_menu.rs, revision 0d0ea352df99044589a7ce0efc7004f7a5b6b7c0
  (closing an open menu on a click or Escape, and its tests, in crates/menu/src/driver.rs).
  https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft
  Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the VectorCraft contributors.
  Both licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0.
The egui menu bar in crates/menu/src/bar (its menu navigation, scrolling, submenu hover
intent, keyboard access and mnemonics, and their tests) is ported from:
- PhotoCraft, crates/ui-egui/src/menu_nav.rs and menu_nav_tests.rs, menu_keys.rs and
  menu_keys_tests.rs, and the menu bar in crates/ui-egui/src/menus.rs, revision
  c36e46c3873ee39f299cc50a3dcd28494c78366d.
  https://github.com/storytold/photocraft
  Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the PhotoCraft contributors, among them aiongg, artman67,
  BFlat, Brandon Thomas, Brennan Stehling, Daniel Lošák, David Mann, Fabio Lissi, FredApps,
  Higgs32584, itsF4LCON, jason4short, Korg1ch, MarekSpodBiedry and Nigel Ihza Firdausy.
  Licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0. PhotoCraft's menus, theme and Help search are not copied.

The colour management module in crates/cms is extracted from:
- PhotoCraft, crates/cms, revision b3222ee8e7e6bcb4799c37f904c595f20f9baf5e.
  https://github.com/storytold/photocraft
  Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the PhotoCraft contributors.
  Licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0. Its generated ICC profile is dedicated to the public domain
  (CC0-1.0); see ATTRIBUTION.md.

Optional PDF writer

Krilla 0.8.2 (https://github.com/LaurenzV/krilla), MIT OR Apache-2.0.
Upstream licence texts are retained in licenses/pdf-writer.
The optional writer embeds Compact ICC Profiles by Clinton Ingram
(https://github.com/saucecontrol/Compact-ICC-Profiles), under CC0-1.0.
See licenses/pdf-writer/LICENSE-ICC.txt and ATTRIBUTION.md for sources and hashes.
The writer adds no font files. Its four existing ICC profiles are retained under vendor/krilla/icc.

Krilla is vendored with the local patches in vendor/krilla/patches; see vendor/krilla/README.craft.md
and vendor/krilla/SOURCE.json. Its upstream MIT/Apache-2.0 licences and CC0 profiles are unchanged.

Optional PDF reader

Hayro 0.7.1, hayro-interpret 0.7.0, hayro-syntax 0.7.2, hayro-jbig2 0.3.0, hayro-cmap 0.1.0
and hayro-postscript 0.1.0 (https://github.com/LaurenzV/hayro), MIT OR Apache-2.0, retain their
upstream licence files. The first five are patched sources transferred from PdfCraft
(https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft): hayro-cmap from revision
a2ec27b4775f53c40cad3456936d9406611e3a8d, the others from revision
ec0a965074f376a5bf610435948e4e5184bf3299. hayro-postscript is the crates.io 0.1.0 package
(upstream revision a2354aebaf86f5ab13e5fd6b6b0521306488bf9d) with one local patch.
See vendor/README.craft-reader.md and each crate's SOURCE.json for provenance and local changes.
The hayro-interpret plate mode (separations, overprint and output-intent simulation) is ported
from PdfCraft pull request #2770 by Guillem Hermida, commit
6fcf2a4aca29e943e28cb69017ff8f87d00656c6 (https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2770),
MIT OR Apache-2.0; crates/pdf/tests/plates.rs and tests/support/synthetic_icc.rs adapt its tests.
Knockout transparency groups in hayro-interpret and hayro are ported from PdfCraft pull request
#2974 by mtlcl410, commit bae69819594a6385a027fec1f67e6b3c36c259b4
(https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2974), MIT OR Apache-2.0;
crates/pdf/tests/knockout.rs adapts its test.
The reader retains the existing Foxit/PDFium standard-14 font assets (BSD-3-Clause),
Compact ICC Profiles by Clinton Ingram (CC0-1.0), and dependency CMaps (BSD-3-Clause).
Their licences and per-file hashes are retained in vendor/hayro-interpret/assets,
vendor/hayro-cmap/assets, licenses/pdf-backend and ATTRIBUTION.md. These are existing reader dependency assets;
applications retain their own document-font selection and licensing policy.

linesweeper

linesweeper 0.5.0 (https://crates.io/crates/linesweeper/0.5.0), MIT OR Apache-2.0, is stored in
vendor/linesweeper with its upstream license files and no file changed. Its manifest names Joe Neeman
as author, and its LICENSE-MIT reads "Copyright (c) 2018 Raph Levien". See
vendor/linesweeper/README.craft.md and vendor/linesweeper/SOURCE.json for provenance and the files
left out.

Platform lifecycle source provenance

The optional crates/platform services adapt the preserved local platform candidate
9b135779a1e7136438a217c18afe1693ea23f1ab (dialog outcomes and browser resource ownership),
and current application implementations:
- PdfCraft crates/platform/src/desktop_theme.rs, a8cd797a917b1007544575c7280c9a0ce6a17e8f.
- CADCraft apps/cadcraft/src/desktop_theme.rs, 0cc66ad3066e71f2c3d4cacb7de905e79ba1c95b.
- ArtCraft Launcher apps/artcraft-launcher/src/system_theme.rs, f1676dfb41c226b5be490721f486ee6427419d80.
- Earlier PhotoCraft, FilmCraft and EffectCraft appearance services at revisions
  0c72d95425dece90ef9a1cceb49e3315c96e22d5, 794a25fc9ed2e3f6fab51a254625bc9b99a88015
  and 1b4d47f34f2b1c1b4a89f4b7348889def8fd648b respectively.
Sources: https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft, https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft,
https://github.com/storytold/craft-launcher, https://github.com/storytold/photocraft,
https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft, https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft.
Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the respective application and craft-libs contributors.
All adapted source is licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0.

The Canon CRW decoder in crates/crw (src/lib.rs, src/tables.rs, src/tests.rs, tests/) and its
derivation record (crates/crw/clean-room/) come from:
- LightCraft, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw.rs, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw_tables.rs,
  crates/raw/tests/crw_oracle.rs, crates/raw/tests/it/vendor_robust.rs and clean-room/crw/,
  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3021, revision 6ca439b5155820d2befeacd81ec0c6a80b2bd3bc
  (decoder ported at 70c755e42a65661401142819278d51b0c5977f7f; the record is identical at both).
  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft
  Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the LightCraft contributors.
Its white-level plateau estimate (saturation_plateau) is LightCraft's vendor::white_from_data at the
same revision. The CRW compression was derived clean-room from CC0 sample files and the
maintainer's own photographs by black-box comparison with a reference decoder's command-line
output; no raw-decoder source was consulted (crates/crw/clean-room/sources.md).

crates/audio/src/alac/ (the ALAC decoder and encoder) is ported from Apple's ALAC reference
implementation, https://github.com/macosforge/alac at c38887c5c5e64a4b31108733bd79ca9b2496d987
(codec/), Copyright (c) 2011 Apple Inc., licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
(LICENSE-APACHE). The files are modified: translated to Rust, with bounds checks on hostile input,
wrapping integer arithmetic, the unrolled predictor and per-width matrix routines folded into one,
and the average bit rate filled in. Those files are Apache-2.0 only.

  https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft

  Licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0.

Optional PDF writer

Krilla 0.8.2 (https://github.com/LaurenzV/krilla), MIT OR Apache-2.0.
Upstream licence texts are retained in licenses/pdf-writer.
The optional writer embeds Compact ICC Profiles by Clinton Ingram
(https://github.com/saucecontrol/Compact-ICC-Profiles), under CC0-1.0.
See licenses/pdf-writer/LICENSE-ICC.txt and ATTRIBUTION.md for sources and hashes.
The writer adds no font files. Its four existing ICC profiles are retained under vendor/krilla/icc.

Krilla is vendored with the local patches in vendor/krilla/patches; see vendor/krilla/README.craft.md
and vendor/krilla/SOURCE.json. Its upstream MIT/Apache-2.0 licences and CC0 profiles are unchanged.

Optional PDF reader

Hayro 0.7.1, hayro-interpret 0.7.0, hayro-syntax 0.7.2, hayro-jbig2 0.3.0, hayro-cmap 0.1.0
and hayro-postscript 0.1.0 (https://github.com/LaurenzV/hayro), MIT OR Apache-2.0, retain their
upstream licence files. The first five are patched sources transferred from PdfCraft
(https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft): hayro-cmap from revision
a2ec27b4775f53c40cad3456936d9406611e3a8d, the others from revision
ec0a965074f376a5bf610435948e4e5184bf3299. hayro-postscript is the crates.io 0.1.0 package
(upstream revision a2354aebaf86f5ab13e5fd6b6b0521306488bf9d) with one local patch.
See vendor/README.craft-reader.md and each crate's SOURCE.json for provenance and local changes.
The hayro-interpret plate mode (separations, overprint and output-intent simulation) is ported
from PdfCraft pull request #2770 by Guillem Hermida, commit
6fcf2a4aca29e943e28cb69017ff8f87d00656c6 (https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2770),
MIT OR Apache-2.0; crates/pdf/tests/plates.rs and tests/support/synthetic_icc.rs adapt its tests.
Knockout transparency groups in hayro-interpret and hayro are ported from PdfCraft pull request
#2974 by mtlcl410, commit bae69819594a6385a027fec1f67e6b3c36c259b4
(https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2974), MIT OR Apache-2.0;
crates/pdf/tests/knockout.rs adapts its test.
The reader retains the existing Foxit/PDFium standard-14 font assets (BSD-3-Clause),
Compact ICC Profiles by Clinton Ingram (CC0-1.0), and dependency CMaps (BSD-3-Clause).
Their licences and per-file hashes are retained in vendor/hayro-interpret/assets,
vendor/hayro-cmap/assets, licenses/pdf-backend and ATTRIBUTION.md. These are existing reader dependency assets;
applications retain their own document-font selection and licensing policy.

linesweeper

linesweeper 0.5.0 (https://crates.io/crates/linesweeper/0.5.0), MIT OR Apache-2.0, is stored in
vendor/linesweeper with its upstream license files and one local patch. Its manifest names Joe Neeman
as author, and its LICENSE-MIT reads "Copyright (c) 2018 Raph Levien". See
vendor/linesweeper/README.craft.md and vendor/linesweeper/SOURCE.json for provenance, the local patch
and the files left out.

Platform lifecycle source provenance

The optional crates/platform services adapt the preserved local platform candidate
9b135779a1e7136438a217c18afe1693ea23f1ab (dialog outcomes and browser resource ownership),
and current application implementations:
- PdfCraft crates/platform/src/desktop_theme.rs, a8cd797a917b1007544575c7280c9a0ce6a17e8f.
- CADCraft apps/cadcraft/src/desktop_theme.rs, 0cc66ad3066e71f2c3d4cacb7de905e79ba1c95b.
- ArtCraft Launcher apps/artcraft-launcher/src/system_theme.rs, f1676dfb41c226b5be490721f486ee6427419d80.
- Earlier PhotoCraft, FilmCraft and EffectCraft appearance services at revisions
  0c72d95425dece90ef9a1cceb49e3315c96e22d5, 794a25fc9ed2e3f6fab51a254625bc9b99a88015
  and 1b4d47f34f2b1c1b4a89f4b7348889def8fd648b respectively.
Sources: https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft, https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft,
https://github.com/storytold/craft-launcher, https://github.com/storytold/photocraft,
https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft, https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft.
Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the respective application and craft-libs contributors.
All adapted source is licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0.

The Canon CRW decoder in crates/crw (src/lib.rs, src/tables.rs, src/tests.rs, tests/) and its
derivation record (crates/crw/clean-room/) come from:
- LightCraft, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw.rs, crates/raw/src/vendor/crw_tables.rs,
  crates/raw/tests/crw_oracle.rs, crates/raw/tests/it/vendor_robust.rs and clean-room/crw/,
  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3021, revision 6ca439b5155820d2befeacd81ec0c6a80b2bd3bc
  (decoder ported at 70c755e42a65661401142819278d51b0c5977f7f; the record is identical at both).
  https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft
  Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the LightCraft contributors.
Its white-level plateau estimate (saturation_plateau) is LightCraft's vendor::white_from_data at the
same revision. The CRW compression was derived clean-room from CC0 sample files and the
maintainer's own photographs by black-box comparison with a reference decoder's command-line
output; no raw-decoder source was consulted (crates/crw/clean-room/sources.md).

crates/audio/src/alac/ (the ALAC decoder and encoder) is ported from Apple's ALAC reference
implementation, https://github.com/macosforge/alac at c38887c5c5e64a4b31108733bd79ca9b2496d987
(codec/), Copyright (c) 2011 Apple Inc., licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
(LICENSE-APACHE). The files are modified: translated to Rust, with bounds checks on hostile input,
wrapping integer arithmetic, the unrolled predictor and per-width matrix routines folded into one,
and the average bit rate filled in. Those files are Apache-2.0 only.

--- 053-epaint_default_fonts-0.37.0/36dbbfd79d73-egui-icons.txt ---
egui-icons.ttf

A subset of emoji-icon-font.ttf (https://github.com/jslegers/emoji-icon-font),
containing only the five glyphs that egui exposes as `egui::special_emojis`:

    U+E618  the Android logo
    U+E61F  the Windows logo
    U+E624  the GitHub logo
    U+E625  the word `git`
    U+F8FF  the Apple logo

No platform font has these, so egui bundles them even when the rest of
emoji-icon-font.ttf is left out (the `monochrome_emoji_fonts` feature).

Regenerate with:

    pip install fonttools
    python3 -m fontTools.subset emoji-icon-font.ttf \
        --unicodes=E618,E61F,E624,E625,F8FF \
        --no-hinting --desubroutinize \
        --output-file=egui-icons.ttf

The license is that of emoji-icon-font.ttf: see emoji-icon-font-mit-license.txt.

--- 088-filmcraft-ui-egui-0.20.1/6a14dbbef713-graphics_notice.rs ---
//! The notice shown while the window runs in a fallback graphics mode (#820): the desktop app
//! moved on to DirectX 12 only or a software adapter after earlier starts died in the graphics
//! driver. It says so and offers a one-click way back to the default mode for the next start.
//!
//! Automation ids: `graphics.notice` (the notice), `graphics.notice.reset` (Use Default Graphics),
//! `graphics.notice.close`.

use crate::{FilmcraftApp, i18n};

/// Puts the default graphics mode back for the next start; the error says what could not be saved.
pub type ResetFn = Box<dyn FnMut() -> Result<(), String>>;

/// A fallback graphics mode, as the host reports it.
pub struct GraphicsNotice {
    /// The mode's English name ("DirectX 12 only", "software rendering"), translated when shown.
    pub mode: String,
    reset: ResetFn,
    /// The default mode is saved for the next start.
    pub reset_done: bool,
    /// Closed for this session.
    pub closed: bool,
}

impl GraphicsNotice {
    pub fn new(mode: &str, reset: ResetFn) -> Self {
        Self { mode: mode.to_string(), reset, reset_done: false, closed: false }
    }

    /// Use Default Graphics: save the default mode for the next start.
    pub fn reset(&mut self) -> Result<(), String> {
        (self.reset)()?;
        self.reset_done = true;
        Ok(())
    }
}

/// Draw the notice (bottom right, above the status bar) until it is closed.
pub(crate) fn show(app: &mut FilmcraftApp, ctx: &egui::Context) {
    let Some(mut notice) = app.graphics_notice.take() else { return };
    if notice.closed {
        app.graphics_notice = Some(notice);
        return;
    }
    let title = tlf!("Safe graphics mode: {mode}", mode = i18n::t(&notice.mode));
    let (mut reset, mut close) = (false, false);
    let shown = egui::Window::new("graphics-notice")
        .id(egui::Id::unique("graphics-notice"))
        .title_bar(false)
        .collapsible(false)
        .resizable(false)
        .anchor(egui::Align2::RIGHT_BOTTOM, [-12.0, -32.0])
        .show(ctx, |ui| {
            ui.set_max_width(360.0);
            ui.label(egui::RichText::new(&title).strong());
            ui.add_space(4.0);
            if notice.reset_done {
                ui.label(tl!("The default graphics are used from the next start."));
            } else {
                ui.label(tl!("An earlier start failed with the default graphics. Updating the graphics driver usually fixes this."));
            }
            ui.add_space(6.0);
            ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                if !notice.reset_done {
                    let label = tl!("Use Default Graphics");
                    let r = ui.button(label);
                    app.auto.add_response("graphics.notice.reset", &r, label);
                    reset = r.clicked();
                }
                let label = tl!("Close");
                let c = ui.button(label);
                app.auto.add_response("graphics.notice.close", &c, label);
                close = c.clicked();
            });
        });
    if let Some(shown) = shown {
        app.auto.add("graphics.notice", shown.response.rect, &title);
    }
    if reset && let Err(e) = notice.reset() {
        app.ui.status = e;
    }
    notice.closed |= close;
    app.graphics_notice = Some(notice);
}


--- 088-filmcraft-ui-egui-0.20.1/0784c769e467-graphics_notice_ui.rs ---
//! The fallback graphics notice (#820): shown while the desktop app runs in a fallback graphics
//! mode, its button saves the default mode for the next start, and it can be closed.

use std::cell::Cell;
use std::rc::Rc;
use std::sync::mpsc::{Sender, channel};

use egui_kittest::Harness;
use filmcraft_engine::Session;
use filmcraft_ui_egui::FilmcraftApp;
use filmcraft_ui_egui::control::ControlRequest;
use filmcraft_ui_egui::graphics_notice::GraphicsNotice;
use serde_json::{Value, json};

struct Driver {
    harness: Harness<'static, FilmcraftApp>,
    tx: Sender<ControlRequest>,
}

impl Driver {
    fn new(notice: Option<GraphicsNotice>) -> Self {
        let (tx, rx) = channel();
        let mut app = FilmcraftApp::new(Session::default()).with_control(rx);
        app.graphics_notice = notice;
        let harness = Harness::builder().with_size(egui::vec2(1600.0, 980.0)).with_max_steps(10_000).build_eframe(move |_cc| app);
        let mut d = Driver { harness, tx };
        d.frames(4);
        d
    }
    fn frames(&mut self, n: usize) {
        for _ in 0..n {
            let ctx = self.harness.ctx.clone();
            let mut raw = std::mem::take(self.harness.input_mut());
            eframe::App::raw_input_hook(self.harness.state_mut(), &ctx, &mut raw);
            *self.harness.input_mut() = raw;
            self.harness.step();
        }
    }
    fn call(&mut self, method: &str, params: Value) -> Value {
        let (req, reply) = ControlRequest::new(method, params.clone());
        self.tx.send(req).unwrap();
        for _ in 0..600 {
            self.frames(1);
            if let Ok(v) = reply.try_recv() {
                return v;
            }
        }
        panic!("no reply to {method} {params}");
    }
    fn ids(&mut self) -> Vec<String> {
        let v = self.call("ui.elements", json!({"prefix": "graphics.notice"}));
        assert_eq!(v["ok"], json!(true), "{v}");
        v["result"].as_array().unwrap().iter().map(|e| e["id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string()).collect()
    }
    fn label(&mut self, id: &str) -> String {
        let v = self.call("ui.elements", json!({"prefix": id}));
        v["result"].as_array().unwrap().iter().find(|e| e["id"] == id).map(|e| e["label"].as_str().unwrap().to_string()).unwrap_or_default()
    }
    fn click(&mut self, id: &str) {
        let v = self.call("ui.click", json!({"id": id}));
        assert_eq!(v["ok"], json!(true), "{id}: {v}");
        self.frames(3);
    }
    fn app(&mut self) -> &mut FilmcraftApp {
        self.harness.state_mut()
    }
}

#[test]
fn no_notice_in_the_default_graphics_mode() {
    let mut d = Driver::new(None);
    assert!(d.ids().is_empty());
}

#[test]
fn the_reset_button_saves_the_default_mode_once_and_close_hides_the_notice() {
    let resets = Rc::new(Cell::new(0));
    let counter = Rc::clone(&resets);
    let notice = GraphicsNotice::new(
        "software rendering",
        Box::new(move || {
            counter.set(counter.get() + 1);
            Ok(())
        }),
    );
    let mut d = Driver::new(Some(notice));
    let ids = d.ids();
    for id in ["graphics.notice", "graphics.notice.reset", "graphics.notice.close"] {
        assert!(ids.iter().any(|i| i == id), "{id} in {ids:?}");
    }
    assert!(d.label("graphics.notice").contains("software rendering"));
    d.click("graphics.notice.reset");
    assert_eq!(resets.get(), 1);
    assert!(d.app().graphics_notice.as_ref().is_some_and(|n| n.reset_done));
    // done: the button is gone, the notice says when it takes effect
    let ids = d.ids();
    assert!(!ids.iter().any(|i| i == "graphics.notice.reset"), "{ids:?}");
    assert!(ids.iter().any(|i| i == "graphics.notice"));
    d.click("graphics.notice.close");
    assert!(d.ids().is_empty());
    assert_eq!(resets.get(), 1);
}

#[test]
fn a_reset_that_cannot_be_saved_says_why_and_keeps_the_button() {
    let notice = GraphicsNotice::new("DirectX 12 only", Box::new(|| Err("can't write graphics-start.json: read-only".into())));
    let mut d = Driver::new(Some(notice));
    d.click("graphics.notice.reset");
    assert!(d.app().ui.status.contains("read-only"), "{}", d.app().ui.status);
    assert!(d.app().graphics_notice.as_ref().is_some_and(|n| !n.reset_done));
    assert!(d.ids().iter().any(|i| i == "graphics.notice.reset"));
}

#[test]
fn the_notice_follows_the_interface_language() {
    let notice = GraphicsNotice::new("software rendering", Box::new(|| Ok(())));
    let mut d = Driver::new(Some(notice));
    let es = filmcraft_ui_egui::i18n::Language::Es;
    d.app().ui.language = es;
    d.frames(3);
    let title = filmcraft_ui_egui::i18n::fmt(es.tr("Safe graphics mode: {mode}"), &[("mode", es.tr("software rendering"))]);
    assert_eq!(d.label("graphics.notice"), title);
    assert_eq!(d.label("graphics.notice.reset"), es.tr("Use Default Graphics"));
    filmcraft_ui_egui::i18n::set_current(filmcraft_ui_egui::i18n::Language::En);
}
